lines.zh: 我的鞋尖太长，走路老是自己绊自己。
lines.en: My shoes are too long; I trip over them constantly.

lines.zh: 铃铛响一路，猎物就一路知道我在。
lines.en: Bells ring the whole way, so prey always hears me coming.

lines.zh: 我一瘸一拐，但从来没停下过。
lines.en: I limp along but have never once stopped.

lines.zh: 破布条从裤脚拖出来，扫着地板。
lines.en: Rags trail from my cuffs and sweep the floor.

lines.zh: 我走三步退一步，这叫舞步。
lines.en: Three steps forward, one back: that is dancing.

lines.zh: 玩具城的走廊窄，我的帽子更高。
lines.en: The halls are narrow; my hat is taller still.

lines.zh: 我的步子乱，但铃铛从不漏拍。
lines.en: My steps are ragged, but the bells never miss a beat.

lines.zh: 我沿着墙根走，那里回声好听。
lines.en: I walk along the wall where echoes sound sweeter.

lines.zh: 鞋底破了个洞，石子在里面打拍子。
lines.en: A hole in my sole lets pebbles keep the beat.

lines.zh: 我绕着你转圈，你别急着走。
lines.en: I circle around you; do not hurry off.

lines.zh: 每走一步，脸上的粉就掉一层。
lines.en: Each step sheds another layer of face powder.

lines.zh: 我追人不靠快，靠你回头那一下。
lines.en: I do not chase fast; I wait for you to look back.

lines.zh: 我坐着抖腿，抖到地板都在响。
lines.en: I sit and jiggle my leg until the floor rattles.

lines.zh: 我把破布摊开，又缝回去，缝得很丑。
lines.en: I spread my rags, sew them back, and do it badly.

lines.zh: 安静下来的时候，脑袋里有掌声。
lines.en: When it grows quiet, I hear applause in my head.

lines.zh: 我练了半天的抛接，接住两个。
lines.en: I practiced juggling all day and caught two.

lines.zh: 我的笑是画到耳朵后面的。
lines.en: My grin is painted all the way to my ears.

lines.zh: 没人看的时候，我也会鞠躬。
lines.en: When nobody watches, I still take a bow.

lines.zh: 数到七我就忘了数到哪。
lines.en: I count to seven and forget where I was.

lines.zh: 玩具城太静，我给自己鼓掌。
lines.en: Toyland is too quiet, so I applaud myself.

lines.zh: 我把帽子里的小球倒出来又装回去。
lines.en: I pour the balls from my hat and put them back.

lines.zh: 发条松了，我的动作就慢半拍。
lines.en: The key winds down and my timing slips half a beat.

lines.zh: 你这么正经，教我怎么笑吧。
lines.en: You look so serious; teach me how to smile.

lines.zh: 你的脸只有一种表情，太单调了。
lines.en: Your face holds one expression only, which is dull.

lines.zh: 我盯着你，是因为你不响铃。
lines.en: I stare because you wear no bells.

lines.zh: 别绷着脸，观众都看着呢。
lines.en: Do not look so stiff; the audience is watching.

lines.zh: 你眨眼了，这算不算笑。
lines.en: You blinked; does that count as laughter?

lines.zh: 我在你眼睛里找到了自己的粉脸。
lines.en: I found my powdered face inside your eyes.

lines.zh: 你看我的时候，掌声更响了。
lines.en: The applause grows louder when you look at me.

lines.zh: 我歪着头，帽尖也跟着歪。
lines.en: I tilt my head; my hat tip tilts too.

lines.zh: 你的嘴角没动，我记下了。
lines.en: Your mouth did not move; I made note of it.

lines.zh: 要不要看一段抛接，很快的。
lines.en: Would you like a juggling act? It is quick.

lines.zh: 打到我了，铃铛替我叫。
lines.en: You hit me, and my bells cry out for me.

lines.zh: 破布又裂了一条口子。
lines.en: Another tear opens in my rags.

lines.zh: 我疼得跳起来，姿势很难看。
lines.en: I jump with the pain; it is not graceful.

lines.zh: 别打脸，粉会呛到你。
lines.en: Not the face; powder will get in your eyes.

lines.zh: 这一下把我打得笑了出来。
lines.en: That blow knocked a laugh out of me.

lines.zh: 我的笑裂了，只剩一半。
lines.en: My grin cracked and only half remains.

lines.zh: 四十二颗半，还够我演的。
lines.en: Forty-two and a half hearts; enough to keep playing.

lines.zh: 你打得不疼，就是有点响。
lines.en: It barely hurts; it is merely loud.

lines.zh: 帽子里的小球全掉了。
lines.en: Every ball in my hat spilled out.

lines.zh: 我的布吸了血，颜色变深了。
lines.en: My cloth drank the blood and deepened in color.

lines.zh: 甜的？我更喜欢看你躲。
lines.en: Sweet? I would rather watch you dodge.

lines.zh: 你把吃的举高了，像在喂鸟。
lines.en: You hold the food up high, as if feeding birds.

lines.zh: 我不吃，我只收破烂布匹。
lines.en: I do not eat; I only collect torn cloth.

lines.zh: 这胡萝卜当道具还不错。
lines.en: That carrot would make a decent prop.

lines.zh: 别拿食物哄我，我的笑会掉。
lines.en: Do not bribe me with food; my grin might fall off.

lines.zh: 我咬不动，我的牙是涂白的。
lines.en: I cannot bite; my teeth are painted white.

lines.zh: 你留着吧，等下逃跑用得着。
lines.en: Keep it; you will need it when you run.

lines.zh: 食物进不了我的肚子，会从缝里掉。
lines.en: Food will slip out through my seams.

lines.zh: 我闻到了，好闻，但我不要。
lines.en: I smell it; it is nice, but I decline.

lines.zh: 你手里有东西，就容易分心。
lines.en: Holding something makes you easy to distract.

lines.zh: 撞上了，算你请我跳一支。
lines.en: We collided, so consider this a dance.

lines.zh: 你把我撞得铃铛乱响。
lines.en: You knocked me so hard my bells clattered.

lines.zh: 我这种身板，撞一下散一半。
lines.en: A body like mine comes half apart on impact.

lines.zh: 你的膝盖顶到我的破布。
lines.en: Your knee catches my torn cloth.

lines.zh: 别躲，撞过来更好玩。
lines.en: Do not dodge; bumping into me is more fun.

lines.zh: 被撞时我笑得更大声。
lines.en: When struck, my laughter only grows louder.

lines.zh: 我们撞在一起，像两袋旧衣服。
lines.en: We crash together like two bags of old clothes.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我的帽子歪了。
lines.en: When you pulled away, my hat went crooked.

lines.zh: 我不介意被挤，我本来就扁。
lines.en: I do not mind being squeezed; I am flat already.

lines.zh: 再撞一下，我给你鞠个躬。
lines.en: Bump me once more and I will bow.

lines.zh: 我这样的，只配和破布作伴。
lines.en: The likes of me only get torn cloth for company.

lines.zh: 舞台灯下只有我一个人。
lines.en: Under the stage lights there is only me.

lines.zh: 没有第二张小丑脸来配我。
lines.en: No second clown face comes to match mine.

lines.zh: 我把笑脸借给过别人，没还回来。
lines.en: I lent my smiling face away and never got it back.

lines.zh: 要伴干什么，我有掌声。
lines.en: Why want a partner? I have applause.

lines.zh: 同类都躲在后台，不肯出来。
lines.en: My kin hide backstage and will not come out.

lines.zh: 我试着牵过手，线就断了。
lines.en: I once tried holding hands, and the thread snapped.

lines.zh: 一个人也能演完全场。
lines.en: I can play the whole show alone.

lines.zh: 别问我这些，铃铛会答。
lines.en: Do not ask me that; my bells will answer.

lines.zh: 两个小丑，只会抢一个观众。
lines.en: Two clowns would only fight over one spectator.

lines.zh: 这个归我了，反正你也不要。
lines.en: This is mine now, since you do not want it.

lines.zh: 我捡东西很快，手比脑子快。
lines.en: I grab fast; my hands outrun my head.

lines.zh: 掉下来的破布，我都收着。
lines.en: I keep every scrap of cloth that falls.

lines.zh: 这枚硬币，等会儿变个戏法。
lines.en: This coin will star in a trick later.

lines.zh: 我口袋里全是碎纸和线头。
lines.en: My pockets hold only torn paper and loose thread.

lines.zh: 你掉的剑我拿不动，太长。
lines.en: I cannot lift your dropped sword; it is too long.

lines.zh: 捡到东西要鞠躬，这是规矩。
lines.en: When I pick something up, I bow; those are the rules.

lines.zh: 别捡我的，我数过的。
lines.en: Do not pick up mine; I have counted them.

lines.zh: 我把箭插在帽子上，当装饰。
lines.en: I stick the arrow in my hat as decoration.

lines.zh: 手里空了，我就捡石头凑数。
lines.en: When my hands are empty, I pick up pebbles.

lines.zh: 来了个观众，前排就座。
lines.en: An audience has arrived; take the front row.

lines.zh: 我一看见你，铃铛先笑了。
lines.en: The moment I see you, my bells laugh first.

lines.zh: 你踩上我的舞台，就是演员了。
lines.en: Step on my stage and you become the act.

lines.zh: 八点伤害，够演完这一场。
lines.en: Eight points of damage will finish this show.

lines.zh: 我闻到你身上的铁味，好极了。
lines.en: I smell iron on you, and it is wonderful.

lines.zh: 谢幕之前，你别走。
lines.en: Do not leave before the curtain call.

lines.zh: 四十二颗半的心，撑得住。
lines.en: Forty-two and a half hearts will hold up fine.

lines.zh: 我把帽檐压低，准备开演。
lines.en: I pull my brim low and prepare to begin.

lines.zh: 新来的，你站在光里了。
lines.en: Newcomer, you are standing in the light.

lines.zh: 你一动，我的戏就有下文。
lines.en: One move from you and my play continues.

lines.zh: 躲到帘子后面也没用。
lines.en: Hiding behind the curtain will not help you.

lines.zh: 我笑的时候最专心。
lines.en: I am at my most focused when laughing.

lines.zh: 这个观众不鼓掌，那就换个方式。
lines.en: This one will not clap, so I will change the act.

lines.zh: 从你踏进门，戏就开锣了。
lines.en: The show began the moment you entered.

lines.zh: 你笑起来像会买票的人。
lines.en: You smile like someone who buys a ticket.

lines.zh: 灯光打在你身上，我就定下你了。
lines.en: The light hits you, and you are my pick.

lines.zh: 我跟着你转，帽子上的铃一路响。
lines.en: I turn as you turn, bells ringing the whole way.

lines.zh: 你退一步，我就向前鞠一躬。
lines.en: You step back; I bow one step forward.

lines.zh: 别看我手，看我的鞋。
lines.en: Do not watch my hands; watch my shoes.

lines.zh: 我的笑不动，眼睛跟着你走。
lines.en: My grin stays fixed; my eyes follow you.

lines.zh: 你在数我还有多少破布吧。
lines.en: You are counting how much torn cloth I have left.

lines.zh: 舞台边上有我埋的线，小心。
lines.en: I buried thread along the stage edge; mind it.

lines.zh: 抛接练了这么久，接的是你。
lines.en: I practiced juggling so long; now I catch you.

lines.zh: 你一停，我的节奏就乱了。
lines.en: When you stop, my rhythm falls apart.

lines.zh: 我把你围在中间，别急。
lines.en: I have circled you in; no need to rush.

lines.zh: 你举盾的样子，挡不住笑声。
lines.en: Raise your shield; it will not block laughter.

lines.zh: 脚踝伤了吧，我看得出来。
lines.en: Your ankle is hurt; I can tell from here.

lines.zh: 再退就到墙了，那里回声最大。
lines.en: One more step and the wall echoes loudest.

lines.zh: 我的头在歪，那是准备起跳。
lines.en: My head is tilting; that means I am about to leap.

lines.zh: 这出戏的长短，由你决定。
lines.en: How long this show runs is up to you.

lines.zh: 我在你左右蹦，绳子松了。
lines.en: I bounce from side to side and my cord comes loose.

lines.zh: 你数我的脚步，数不清。
lines.en: You try to count my steps and lose track.

lines.zh: 我绕圈，让你的剑跟不上。
lines.en: I circle so your blade cannot keep up.

lines.zh: 我退半步，是让你再进来。
lines.en: I step back half a pace so you come in.

lines.zh: 我脚尖点地，数到二。
lines.en: I tap my toes and count to two.

lines.zh: 你踩着我的彩带了吗，麻烦。
lines.en: Are you standing on my ribbon? How rude.

lines.zh: 这一巴掌带响，观众爱听。
lines.en: This slap rings out; audiences love the sound.

lines.zh: 八点，不多不少，正好够疼。
lines.en: Eight points, no more, no less, just enough pain.

lines.zh: 我打你，是为了让你记得鼓掌。
lines.en: I hit you so you remember to clap.

lines.zh: 手指撞歪了，我掰回来。
lines.en: My finger bent crooked; I snap it back.

lines.zh: 粉从我袖子里炸开，好看吧。
lines.en: Powder bursts from my sleeve; lovely, is it not?

lines.zh: 别捂脸，脸我留着有用。
lines.en: Do not cover your face; I have plans for it.

lines.zh: 我打完会笑，这是本能。
lines.en: I laugh after striking; it is pure instinct.

lines.zh: 你的护甲响了，像小铜锣。
lines.en: Your armor rings out like a small gong.

lines.zh: 这一拳我练了两百遍。
lines.en: I have practiced this punch two hundred times.

lines.zh: 打在你肩上，我的袖子裂了。
lines.en: The blow landed on your shoulder and split my sleeve.

lines.zh: 疼吗？我也疼，可我不停。
lines.en: Does it hurt? So do I, but I do not stop.

lines.zh: 你退开时，我正好换只手。
lines.en: As you fall back, I switch hands.

lines.zh: 这一下是谢幕礼，收好。
lines.en: This one is a curtain-call gift; take it.

lines.zh: 我下手不重，只是花样多。
lines.en: My blows are light; there are simply many of them.

lines.zh: 我用手肘顶你的下巴。
lines.en: I drive my elbow into your chin.

lines.zh: 这一脚踢在你膝盖侧面。
lines.en: This kick lands on the side of your knee.

lines.zh: 我的帽子飞出去，砸在你脸上。
lines.en: My hat flies off and hits you in the face.

lines.zh: 我抓住你的手腕，转半圈。
lines.en: I grab your wrist and twist it half a turn.

lines.zh: 那团粉烟，你别吸。
lines.en: Do not breathe that pink smoke.

lines.zh: 我撞你一下，然后鞠躬道歉。
lines.en: I ram you once, then bow an apology.

lines.zh: 灯亮了，我该上场了。
lines.en: The lights came up; time for me to enter.

lines.zh: 我从一堆破布里站起来，抖了抖。
lines.en: I rise from a heap of rags and shake myself.

lines.zh: 铃铛先响，然后才有我。
lines.en: The bells ring first; only then do I exist.

lines.zh: 谁把我的脸画歪了，也好。
lines.en: Someone painted my face crooked; that is fine.

lines.zh: 玩具城今天多了个小丑。
lines.en: Toyland has one more clown today.

lines.zh: 我一出生就鞠了一躬。
lines.en: I took a bow the moment I was born.

lines.zh: 脚底发凉，大概是地板的错。
lines.en: My feet feel cold; probably the floor's fault.

lines.zh: 我数了数，还是没有人。
lines.en: I counted; there is still nobody here.

lines.zh: 我的帽子落在原地，我捡起来了。
lines.en: My hat was left behind; I picked it up.

lines.zh: 这次我想演个不一样的。
lines.en: This time I want to play a different role.

lines.zh: 缝我的线还没剪断，我拖着走。
lines.en: The thread that made me still hangs; I drag it.

lines.zh: 睁眼第一件事，先笑一个。
lines.en: First thing on waking: put on the smile.

lines.zh: 火顺着破布爬，一圈一圈地烧。
lines.en: Fire climbs the rags, burning in rings.

lines.zh: 落地时铃铛先响，我才落地。
lines.en: The bells rang first; only then did I land.

lines.zh: 水里的掌声听起来很远。
lines.en: Underwater, the applause sounds very far away.

lines.zh: 炸得我帽子飞了，头还在。
lines.en: The blast took my hat; my head stayed.

lines.zh: 箭把我钉在门板上，我还在笑。
lines.en: The arrow pins me to the door, and I still laugh.

lines.zh: 那味道让我的笑开始发抖。
lines.en: That smell makes my painted smile shake.

lines.zh: 我不饿，可我的身体在叫。
lines.en: I am not hungry, but my body begs.

lines.zh: 雷把我照亮，观众一定看清了。
lines.en: Lightning lit me up; the audience surely saw.

lines.zh: 虚空里没有回声，我不喜欢。
lines.en: The void has no echo, and I dislike that.
